title: The Bone Auction
text: A hooded auctioneer sets up on the cathedral steps at midnight and rings a handbell made of a jawbone. One lot only: the right hand of the last bishop, still warm, still blessing. Bids are sealed, and he keeps them all.

options.label: Send a sealed bid to the cathedral steps, and hope the bishop's hand blesses your House.

outcomes.text: Your bid is folded into the auctioneer's sleeve. He does not count it.

options.label: Keep your people indoors until dawn. Nothing sold at midnight is worth the price.

outcomes.text: Your doors stay shut. Something taps on them, politely, until the bell stops.

together.text: Nobody bids. The auctioneer bows to the empty square and burns the lot on the steps; the smoke smells of incense and hair, and the cathedral bell cracks.

prize.text: The hand is delivered in a silver cage before sunrise. It is blessing the servant who carries it, and the servant is weeping.
